item.title: U.S. threatens "economic D-Day" sanctions on Iran
item.description:
Published: 2026-08-25
This photo taken on Aug. 24, 2026 shows the U.S. Department of the Treasury in Washington, D.C., the United States. (Xinhua/Li Rui)
NEW YORK, Aug. 24 (Xinhua) -- U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Monday threatened Iran with "an economic D-Day," announcing a wave of new sanctions aimed at further isolating the country.
"We are launching an economic onslaught against Iran's financial connections around the globe," said Bessent at a press conference. "Our objective is to sever every economic lifeline" that sustains the country, he said.
The U.S. Treasury Department said in a press release that the new sectoral sanctions determinations target five critical sectors -- digital assets, technology, gold, aviation and shipping -- that the U.S. says Iran has relied on to prop up its economy.
The measures marked the beginning of "a sustained and systematic campaign to close every financial resource" that supports Iran, the department said. It added that "any entity that facilitates money laundering or sanctions evasion on behalf of Iran risks being cut off from the U.S. financial system."
The department is expanding the categories of "Iran-related conduct" that the United States might sanction in the future, and said "every country will be given a defined timeline to shut down the Iran-related activity" the United States has identified.
Bessent disclosed that U.S. President Donald Trump has been calling world leaders with specific requests to cease their interactions with Iran.
Simultaneously, the department's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctioned nearly 60 entities, individuals, and vessels in multiple jurisdictions that enable Iran's activities, including illicit nuclear and missile technology procurement, cyber operations, and oil-revenue generation networks.
OFAC also suspended several general licenses that previously authorized certain remittance payments to Iran and Iranian access to the U.S. cultural and academic system.
Additionally, the Treasury Department released additional guidance on the sanctions risks associated with complying with Iranian demands regarding shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.
In a post on X, Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf responded to U.S. economic threats against Tehran by saying that, "Iran's trading partners, both in the media and through messages sent to us, have made it clear that they don't take these statements into account anywhere."
"They cannot cut off our financial lifelines," Iran's Minister of Economic Affairs and Finance Seyed Ali Madanizadeh said in another X post, adding that Tehran has been "planning for some time to counter the sanctions."

item.title: Xi puts forward four principles on Palestinian question
item.description:
Published: 2026-08-25
Chinese President Xi Jinping holds talks with King of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan Abdullah II ibn Al Hussein, who is on a state visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, capital of China, Aug. 24, 2026. (Xinhua/Li Xiang)
BEIJING, Aug. 24 (Xinhua) -- Chinese President Xi Jinping stressed on Monday that four principles should be followed to push for the resolution of the Palestinian question, which is at the heart of the Middle East issue.
Xi made the remarks in talks with King of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan Abdullah II ibn Al Hussein in Beijing.
First, a political settlement should be upheld. The two-state solution is the right direction, and efforts should be made to restart peace talks between Palestine and Israel, with a view to establishing an independent Palestinian state at an early date, Xi said.
Second, the principle of "Palestinians governing Palestine" should be followed in advancing the governance of the West Bank and the post-war reconstruction of Gaza, he said.
Third, humanitarian principles must be upheld. The international community, and the UN Security Council in particular, should shoulder its responsibility effectively to protect civilian safety, ensure the flow of humanitarian assistance, and put an end to humanitarian disasters, Xi said.
Fourth, fairness and justice must be upheld. This means following international law, addressing both symptoms and root causes, and taking practical actions so that the Palestinian question can be resolved in a comprehensive, just and lasting way at an early date, he said.
On the Middle East situation, Xi said China has always advocated a comprehensive ceasefire and end of hostilities, and resolving disputes through political and diplomatic means, adding that the sovereignty and security of Jordan and all other countries in the region should be respected.
Noting Jordan appreciates China's impartial stance on Middle East affairs and its support for the just cause of Arab countries, King Abdullah II said Jordan is ready to maintain close communication with China and continue to make active efforts for de-escalation.

item.title: Xi congratulates Alamgir on assuming Bangladeshi presidency
item.description:
Published: 2026-08-25
BEIJING, Aug. 24 (Xinhua) -- Chinese President Xi Jinping on Monday extended congratulations to Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir on assuming the office as president of Bangladesh.
In his congratulatory message, Xi noted China and Bangladesh are traditional friendly neighbors.
Xi said that since the establishment of diplomatic ties 51 years ago, the two countries have enjoyed mutual respect, treated each other as equals, supported each other on issues of their respective core interests and major concerns, and joined hands on their paths towards modernization.
Bilateral relations have withstood the tests of a rapidly changing international situation, Xi said.
Xi said he attaches great importance to the development of China-Bangladesh relations, and is willing to work with Alamgir to carry forward the traditional friendship, strengthen strategic communication, advance high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, deepen exchanges and cooperation in all fields, and guide the building of a China-Bangladesh community with a shared future in the new era to go deeper and more solid, so as to better benefit the two peoples.

item.title: Xi stresses consolidating, expanding campaign on correct view of governance performance
item.description:
Published: 2026-08-25
BEIJING, Aug. 24 (Xinhua) -- Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee, has emphasized the importance of consolidating and expanding the progress made in a Party-wide study and education campaign for establishing and practicing a correct understanding of governance performance.
Xi, also Chinese president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, made the remarks in a recent instruction, which was studied at a meeting of the CPC Central Leading Group for Party Building held on Monday.
Xi stressed that establishing and putting into practice a correct view of governance performance is a long-term task that requires sustained efforts.
Since the 18th CPC National Congress, the organization of study and education campaigns across the Party to address major and pressing issues in Party building has become an important institutional arrangement, Xi said, lauding the notable results achieved in the latest campaign.
Xi emphasized the need to regularly conduct education on the correct view of governance performance, guiding Party members and officials to always take responsibility, perform their duties and fulfill their obligations in accordance with such a view.
Efforts should also be made to improve differentiated assessment and evaluation systems, and establish a personnel selection and appointment orientation that values solid work and concrete results, Xi said.
During the meeting, participants thoroughly studied and implemented Xi's instruction, reviewed the campaign, and made arrangements for consolidating and expanding the campaign's outcomes and establishing a long-term mechanism accordingly.
The meeting was chaired by Cai Qi, who is head of the CPC Central Leading Group for Party Building, and was also attended by Li Xi, the group's deputy head. Cai and Li, both of whom are members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, also delivered speeches.
The meeting noted that the campaign has resolved prominent issues related to deviations in view of governance performance, regulated the official conduct of leading officials at all levels, and given a strong boost to all work aimed at ensuring a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030).
The campaign, which started in late February, has basically concluded and aimed to correct misguided views on governance that often breed vanity projects, hidden risks, heavy burdens on local communities, and public discontent.

item.title: BeiDou support tops 98 pct of China's H1 phone shipments as commercial adoption broadens
item.description:
Published: 2026-08-25
A visitor learns about an urban safety risk comprehensive monitoring and early warning platform equipped with BeiDou Navigation Satellite System (BDS) during the 4th International Summit on BDS Applications in Zhuzhou, central China's Hunan Province, Sept. 24, 2025. (Xinhua/Chen Sihan)
BEIJING, Aug. 24 (Xinhua) -- More than 98 percent of the 133 million mobile phones shipped in China's domestic market in the first half (H1) of 2026 supported the BeiDou Navigation Satellite System (BDS), as this technology expands across consumer devices, transport and other industries, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) said on Monday.
Over 14 million shared two-wheelers had adopted BeiDou independent positioning by the end of June, accounting for more than 90 percent of the country's total fleet.
These figures highlight the growing rollout of BeiDou, China's global satellite navigation system, across consumer and industrial applications.
At a media roundtable on large-scale BeiDou applications, Shi Huikang, deputy director of the MIIT's department of electronic information, said China has stepped up pilot programs, product promotion, standards development and ecosystem building in recent years to accelerate adoption.
China's domestic supply base has also continued to expand. By the end of 2025, cumulative shipments of domestically produced BeiDou-compatible chips and modules had approached 2.6 billion units, while the installed base of terminal products with BeiDou functions had exceeded 2.2 billion units, according to the ministry.
Authorities have also supported the development and commercialization of high-precision, interference-resistant and low-power products, helping improve performance and lower costs.
Deployment has also expanded across 39 pilot cities for large-scale BeiDou applications, which had introduced more than 12 million terminals using BeiDou independent positioning by the end of June.
In a number of cities, designated sectors including shared two-wheelers, taxis, government vehicles, agricultural machinery and police equipment have achieved 100-percent BeiDou adoption, the ministry said.
BeiDou's footprint is also expanding across major industries. China now has nearly 40 million BeiDou terminal devices in key sectors, where overall application penetration stands at about 90 percent. More than 160 million wearable devices support BeiDou positioning, while over 100 million passenger vehicles have been equipped with BeiDou-based positioning devices.
Industry data released in May revealed the scale of the broader market. China's satellite navigation industry generated 629 billion yuan (roughly 92.7 billion U.S. dollars) in output in 2025, up 9.24 percent year on year, according to a white paper released by the Global Navigation Satellite System and Location-Based Services Association of China.
The white paper also said BeiDou services and related products have been exported to more than 140 countries and regions worldwide. It said the sector is upgrading toward a broader BeiDou spatiotemporal industry integrating satellite navigation with mobile communications, indoor positioning and artificial intelligence.
During the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030), the MIIT said it will work with other authorities to support breakthroughs in key technologies and their industrial application, while continuing pilot programs for large-scale BeiDou deployment.
The ministry also plans to foster a broader spatiotemporal information industry by promoting coordinated development across satellite positioning, navigation and timing, remote sensing, geographic information systems, communications and satellite internet.

item.title: 2026 APEC SME ministerial meeting to focus on innovation, cooperation
item.description:
Published: 2026-08-25
A themed installation is pictured at a business district in Shenzhen, south China's Guangdong Province, Aug. 10, 2026. (Xinhua/Liang Xu)
BEIJING, Aug. 24 (Xinhua) -- The 32nd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Small and Medium Enterprises (SME) Ministerial Meeting will be held on Sept. 4 in Guangzhou, south China's Guangdong Province, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) said on Monday.
The meeting, themed "innovation-driven development for win-win cooperation," will bring together SME officials from APEC economies, representatives of the APEC Secretariat, and other guests.
The meeting will focus on technological innovation, digital empowerment and inclusive development, with a joint ministerial statement and other outcome documents expected, according to Liang Zhifeng, director of the SME bureau under the MIIT.
As the host, China hopes that through in-depth exchanges, all economies will reach forward-looking and practical consensus, promote mutual learning of policies and the translation of outcomes, and jointly enhance the innovation capacity, digitalization level and sustainable development capabilities of SMEs in the Asia-Pacific region, said Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology Ke Jixin.
Wang Sheng, vice governor of Guangdong, said that all preparations for the meeting are essentially complete, and all APEC economies had confirmed their participation. More than 2,100 companies from home and abroad have registered for the accompanying exhibitions, with over 3,900 booths planned.
China will host the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen in south China in November this year, which will mark the country's third hosting of the event following Shanghai in 2001 and Beijing in 2014.
This year marks the APEC "China Year," with the theme of "Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together." Approximately 300 APEC-related meetings and events will take place in multiple Chinese cities throughout the year.

item.title: Xi calls on China, Jordan to further deepen alignment of development strategies
item.description:
Published: 2026-08-25
China and Jordan should further deepen the alignment of development strategies, Chinese President Xi Jinping said on Monday.
BEIJING, Aug. 24 (Xinhua) -- China and Jordan should further deepen the alignment of development strategies, Chinese President Xi Jinping said on Monday.
Both sides should enhance cooperation in traditional fields including economy and trade, infrastructure construction, transportation and mining, expand new drivers of cooperation in digital economy, artificial intelligence and green energy, and comprehensively deepen exchanges in education, culture, science and technology, tourism and other areas, Xi said when holding talks with King of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan Abdullah II ibn Al Hussein in Beijing.
Xi noted that in 2015, the two heads of state jointly announced the establishment of China-Jordan strategic partnership, opening a new chapter in the development of bilateral relations.
Facing an international and regional situation characterized by intertwined changes and chaos, building a more substantive and dynamic China-Jordan relationship is in line with the common expectations of the two peoples and also conforms to the general trend of the pursuit of the Global South for strength through unity, he said.
Xi emphasized that China attaches great importance to Jordan's unique and significant role in the region, firmly supports Jordan in safeguarding its national sovereignty, security and development interests, and is willing to maintain close exchanges with Jordan at all levels including the governments, political parties, legislative bodies and localities, and enhance exchanges of experience in governance.
China is willing to work with Jordan to implement the four major global initiatives, enhance coordination and cooperation in multilateral institutions including the United Nations, jointly safeguard the international system with the United Nations at its core and the international order underpinned by international law, and promote the building of a community with a shared future for humanity, Xi said.
King Abdullah II said Jordan and China have established a strong strategic partnership, with fruitful cooperation across various fields. He said Jordan firmly upholds the one-China policy and regards Taiwan as part of China's territory.
Jordan places high priority on its relations with China and is dedicated to expanding cooperation and exchanges in economy and trade, manufacturing, agriculture, science and technology, pharmaceuticals, culture and education, King Abdullah II said, adding that Jordan welcomes more Chinese enterprises to invest there to achieve common development and prosperity.
Jordan speaks highly of the four global initiatives put forward by President Xi and looks forward to China's greater leading role on the global stage, King Abdullah II said.
After the talks, the two heads of state jointly attended a signing ceremony for multiple cooperation documents in areas such as diplomacy, economy and trade, industrial and supply chains, and justice.
The two sides also issued a joint statement on deepening the strategic partnership between China and Jordan.
Prior to the talks in the Great Hall of the People, Xi held a welcome ceremony for King Abdullah II. Xi also hosted a welcome banquet for him in the evening.

item.title: Second edition of World Humanoid Robot Games gets underway in Beijing
item.description:
Published: 2026-08-24
Humanoid robots perform at the opening ceremony of the second World Robot Games at the National Speed Skating Oval in Beijing, China, August 22, 2026. /VCG
The second edition of the World Humanoid Robot Games officially got underway at the National Speed Skating Oval in Beijing on Saturday, as more than 1,000 mechanized entries demonstrated their capabilities in the Chinese capital.
A China-developed robot headlined the first day after clocking a time of 9.39 seconds in the 100-meter dash, surpassing the world record of 9.58 seconds posted by legendary Jamaican sprinter Usain Bolt in 2009. A Beijing-built entry also cleared 2.8843 meters in the standing high jump, exceeding Swedish athlete Rune Almen's human record of 1.90 meters set in 1980.
The robots also demonstrated their competitive prowess in other sports, including tennis, table tennis and football. The Games are scheduled to feature 51 events and 1,301 competitions, attracting 666 teams and 2,056 mechanized entries from around the world. The number of teams marked a 138 percent increase over last year's inaugural edition.
Running from Saturday to Wednesday, this year's World Humanoid Robot Games also expanded the number of scenario-based events designed to simulate real-world applications in logistics, hospitality and household services, with the aim of helping better integrate automated creations into people's daily lives.

item.title: China's wild Asian elephant population nears 400
item.description:
Published: 2026-08-14
Thanks to sustained conservation efforts, China's wild Asian elephant population has more than doubled over the past four decades to nearly 400, according to the latest data from the National Forestry and Grassland Administration (NFGA).
